module: 'Raw Vehicle Data' window of the live Vehicle Editor: displays as a recursive imgui tree the entire vEditor.vehData table (data of the current vehicle, including the jbeam vdata) via imguiUtils.addRecursiveTreeTable. Useful to a modder to inspect the resolved jbeam structure.
notes: Nothing is drawn until the window is open or if vEditor.vehicle/vehData are absent.

menuEntry.desc: 'Raw Vehicle Data': menu label read by editor_veMain.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: draws the window and the data tree if it is open.

open.desc: Opens the window (used by the Vehicle Editor menu).

onSerialize.desc: Returns {windowOpen} to restore the state after Lua reload.

onDeserialized.desc: Restores the open state of the window.
